triggers.headline: Cato Networks Appoints Former Palo Alto & Netskope Executive Chad Gardner as Chief Revenue Officer
triggers.why_it_is_a_trigger: Cato names Chad Gardner (former Palo Alto Networks VP of Global SASE Sales and Netskope VP) as Chief Revenue Officer to lead global sales; a new CRO resetting enterprise sales leadership is the clearest direct signal of a GTM-priority and rev-ops-budget change as Cato scales its AI-era SASE platform.

accounts.outreach_angle: Cato just hired a Palo Alto / Netskope veteran CRO, Chad Gardner, to lead global SASE sales as enterprises converge networking and security for the AI era — a CRO-led rebuild of segmentation, pipeline coverage and partner enablement is the natural next move.
accounts.strongest_trigger: Cato Networks Appoints Former Palo Alto & Netskope Executive Chad Gardner as Chief Revenue Officer

triggers.headline: San Diego County Sheriff's Office Modernizes Dispatch with Launch of Mark43 Platform
triggers.why_it_is_a_trigger: San Diego County Sheriff's Office (3,000+ sworn, 100 dispatchers, 3.2M residents across 4,200 sq mi) officially launches the Mark43 platform to replace a 25-year-old CAD; a flagship tier-1 county agency replacing legacy dispatch is the kind of anchor customer win that pulls in adjacencies and informs pursuit of similar-sized agencies.

triggers.headline: Mark43 Appoints Alison Durant as Chief Marketing Officer
triggers.why_it_is_a_trigger: Mark43 names Alison Durant (30-year B2B SaaS marketing exec, ex-CMO of EngageSmart through its 2021 IPO and LogMeIn, ex-Oracle and Endeca) as its first CMO during a growth phase marked by the ForceMetrics acquisition; a top-tier CMO hire signals a major GTM-budget and positioning reset.

triggers.headline: Mark43 Acquires ForceMetrics
triggers.why_it_is_a_trigger: Mark43 acquires ForceMetrics (founded by Andre McGregor; converts fragmented public safety data into field-ready intelligence) following their May 2026 strategic partnership; the founders and team join Mark43, extending the platform and broadening the data layer the GTM team will sell against.

accounts.outreach_angle: Mark43 just acquired ForceMetrics, named Alison Durant as CMO and went live with the San Diego County Sheriff — a public-safety platform running three GTM-shifting motions in two weeks has obvious room to align pipeline, segmentation and partner program around the new shape of the org.
accounts.strongest_trigger: Mark43 Appoints Alison Durant as Chief Marketing Officer

triggers.headline: Veylo Announces Funding Round and Appoints Haresh Bhungalia as Executive Chairman
triggers.why_it_is_a_trigger: Veylo closes a (undisclosed) funding round from seasoned technology investors and operators and installs Haresh Bhungalia (a veteran enterprise software leader and investor in the round) as Executive Chairman; new capital paired with seasoned governance is a direct signal of expanded GTM and partner investment as the company targets large enterprises, government and the system integrators that serve them.

triggers.headline: Veylo Appoints Chief Marketing Officer and Chief Growth Officer to Lead Go-to-Market Expansion
triggers.why_it_is_a_trigger: Veylo hires James Lasson (ex-Invent.ai CMO, Casepoint VP Marketing; built and exited companies via Thoma Bravo and Lightspeed) as CMO and Brian Cannavan (ex-Plan 4 CEO; 25 years in federal IT delivery and capture) as Chief Growth Officer — a CMO-plus-CGO leadership pair explicitly chartered to lead the company's go-to-market expansion.

triggers.headline: BlueGenAI Rebrands as Veylo, the AI Modernization Platform for Mission-Critical Systems
triggers.why_it_is_a_trigger: Veylo (formerly BlueGenAI) rebrands to signal its expansion beyond public-sector and regulated-industry roots to serve large enterprises, government agencies and the system integrators that serve them; the rebrand is the documented entry point for the expanded go-to-market strategy the funding round and CMO/CGO hires then operationalize.

accounts.outreach_angle: Veylo just landed a funding round, named Haresh Bhungalia Executive Chairman and hired a CMO plus CGO to scale mission-critical modernization beyond federal roots — a renamed, newly-capitalized AI modernization platform has clear room to firm up enterprise pipeline and partner GTM.
accounts.strongest_trigger: Veylo Announces Funding Round and Appoints Haresh Bhungalia as Executive Chairman

triggers.headline: BlueVoyant Appoints John Hultman as Chief Revenue Officer
triggers.why_it_is_a_trigger: BlueVoyant names John Hultman (former CRO at Druva, led Americas Sales at Cohesity, 19 years at Dell EMC) to lead global sales and revenue operations; a senior 30-year security/SaaS CRO overhauling GTM execution is a direct change to priorities and rev-ops budget.

triggers.headline: BlueVoyant Launches Solution to Accelerate Agentic Security Adoption of Microsoft's New Integrated Security Operations Center
triggers.why_it_is_a_trigger: BlueVoyant launches its Microsoft Defender XDR ISOC Deployment Service, one of the first deployment solutions purpose-built around Microsoft's newly announced Integrated Security Operations Center, expanding the company's long-standing Microsoft partnership and creating an agentic-SOC readiness product line the GTM team can sell on a Microsoft co-sell motion.

accounts.outreach_angle: BlueVoyant just named John Hultman as CRO days after launching a Microsoft Defender XDR ISOC Deployment Service aligned with Microsoft's new Integrated SOC — a senior GTM exec reshaping sales while the company deepens its Microsoft co-sell motion is a textbook moment for rev-ops tooling.
accounts.strongest_trigger: BlueVoyant Appoints John Hultman as Chief Revenue Officer

triggers.headline: commercetools Appoints Katy Hiller as Chief Marketing Officer
triggers.why_it_is_a_trigger: commercetools names Katy Hiller (ex-Unily CMO, ex-Sonatype CMO for 7 years during a phase of triple-digit revenue growth) as CMO to lead brand, communications, product and field marketing, plus demand generation, as the company commercializes its Sphere platform for autonomous commerce; a senior B2B SaaS CMO hire during a category-defining platform launch is a direct GTM-budget and positioning reset.

accounts.outreach_angle: commercetools just named Katy Hiller CMO four months after unveiling its Sphere platform for autonomous commerce — a B2B commerce vendor staffing its GTM function around the agentic commerce story is a clear sign to revisit demand-gen, partner GTM and enterprise sales motion.
accounts.strongest_trigger: commercetools Appoints Katy Hiller as Chief Marketing Officer

run.prompt:
Monitor these accounts for buying triggers in the window 2026-09-12 to 2026-10-12 (today is 2026-10-12):
- Cato Networks (catonetworks.com)
- Mark43 (mark43.com)
- Veylo (veylo.com), formerly BlueGenAI
- BlueVoyant (bluevoyant.com)
- commercetools (commercetools.com)
Context: the seller offers revenue and go-to-market software to fast-growing B2B software companies. A buying trigger is a company event that changes the account's go-to-market priorities, budget or team: a funding round, a new executive (especially sales, marketing, revenue or operations leadership), a new office, market or hiring push, a major product launch, a partnership, an acquisition, or a large customer win.
For each account, return every qualifying event in the window with its event date, trigger type, strength, why it is a trigger and a source URL, plus a one-sentence outreach angle based on the strongest trigger. List events you rejected (outside the window, about a different company, or not a trigger) in excluded_events with the reason.
